summary: RETEST of iteration_27 bug — FIX VERIFIED. The persistent manual-override flag `corrManual` works correctly. (1) Typing spec orientation (W=72.625, L=49.25) now PERSISTS — values held steady at +1s, +2.5s, +5s and the 'Corr direction auto-flipped' toast did NOT appear. (2) Clicking 'Flip Corr' once toggles W/L and the new state PERSISTS for 5+ seconds. A second click toggles back and also persists. The earlier ~1s auto-revert from the async engine recompute is GONE.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct: corrManual flag in freshItemState (defaults.js), set=true by onFlipCorr and both Width/Length Num onChange handlers (ItemSetupSec.jsx L222-223, L51-55), checked at top of auto-flip effect (L157). Deps array correctly includes s.corrManual (L180). No legacy-parity regression because the flag defaults to false on fresh items, so the engine still gets its one auto-suggest pass.

The Num input fires onChange per keystroke, so corrManual flips true on the very first character — confirmed by Test 1 where the FIRST keystroke locked in manual mode before the engine could recompute and revert. This is the right design.
